scenes.title: LMU Hybrid Nanosystems near-field inspection laboratory
scenes.institution: Hybrid Nanosystems — Scanning Near-Field Microscopy Laboratory
scenes.reference_notes: Official laboratory page and its installed apparatus photograph reviewed. A broad perforated optical table carries long silver enclosures and multiple smaller sources. A cable-dense vertical rack rises behind the middle of the table. Dark blinds screen the two adjacent window walls; supported optical posts surround the near-field station. The photo documents one optical room corner only. Instrument internals, exact light paths and dimensions are unknown. No optical response, nanometre accuracy or source-media redistribution is authorized.
